Policy: Regional Law 734-OZ “On regulation of some issues of apiculture”.
Policy_Content: This Regional Law regulates individual issues in the field of apiculture in the regional territory and determines powers of the regional state authorities in the field of apiculture. Beekeepers have the right to: (a) use agricultural land and other land for beekeeping, if beekeeping is allowed by land tenure regime, as well as to use land plots provided or purchased for running personal subsidiary smallholdings; (b) receive veterinary services when carrying out activities for prevention and elimination of bee diseases, their treatment, control of pests in bee colonies; (c) receive from regional government authorities within their competence timely, complete and reliable information about the state of environment, as well as situations that pose a danger to bees; and (d) exercise other rights in the field of apiculture provided for regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and the region. Beekeepers are required to: (a) comply with veterinary and sanitary standards and rules for keeping bees; (b) follow the instructions of specialists in the field of veterinary medicine who are authorized persons of bodies and organizations included in the system of State Veterinary Service of the Russian Federation, on conducting measures to prevent bee diseases and combat these diseases; and (c) perform other duties in the field of beekeeping provided for by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and the region. The conservation of bees is ensured by beekeepers, unions (associations) of beekeeping farms, as well as by authorized bodies within the limits of their competence through the organization of activities carried out in accordance with the veterinary legislation of the Russian Federation related to measures to prevent and eliminate bee diseases, prevention of bee poisoning by pesticides and agrochemicals, by preservation of breeding beekeeping products.

Policy: Governmental Decision No. 676-N validating the Regulation on purchase and sale procedure of fertile soil layer removed as a result of construction work.
Policy_Content: This Governmental Decision establishes the procedure for purchase and sale procedure of fertile soil layer removed as a result of construction work on contractual basis. The value of fertile soil layer, calculated by the meter, is determined by the mutual agreement of the landowner and the buyer of the fertile layer, taking into account the qualitative indicators of the fertile layer of the land. The quality indicators of the fertile soil layer are described in a document certifying the quality of soil issued by an accredited laboratory in the field of soil monitoring. The amount received from the sale of the fertile layer of state-owned land shall be transferred to the community budget, and the amount received from the sale of the fertile layer of land excavated from land property owned by legal entities or natural persons shall not be deposited into the budget and shall be managed by the owner. Annex 1 contains the form of permit for the purchase of fertile soil layer removed as a result of construction work. Annex 2 contains the form of purchase and sale contract related to fertile soil layer.

Policy: Order No. 303 of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Ecology validating the forest declaration form, the procedure for its completion and submission, requirements for the format of the forest declaration in electronic form.
Policy_Content: This Regulation establishes the forest declaration form, the procedure for its completion and submission, requirements for the format of the forest declaration in electronic form. The forest declaration is submitted annually by persons to whom forest plots are provided for permanent (perpetual) use or lease, or by persons who use forests on the basis of an easement, public easement, to state authorities, local governments within their powers, in electronic form, signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, in the ways determined by the forest legislation. The forest declaration is submitted at least 6 working days before the start of the expected period of forest use. The validity period of the forest declaration is no more than 12 months from the date of the start of the expected period of use of forests and can be extended in cases established by the rules for logging and the specifics of logging in forest areas. The forest declaration reflects information about the person who filed the forest declaration; on a lease contract for a forest plot or other document in accordance with which the use of forests is carried out; on the location of the forest area (the name of the forestry, the name of the local forestry, the name of the tract (if any), the number of the forest quarter, the number of the forest taxation allotment); on the volume of forest use; on the types of use of forests, which are provided for by the lease contract for a forest plot or other document in accordance with which the use of forests is carried out, the forest development project for the declared period.

Policy: Regulation No. 2021/783 of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing a Programme for the Environment and Climate Action (LIFE), and repealing Regulation (EU) No. 1293/2013.
Policy_Content: This Regulation establishes the LIFE Programme, Programme for the Environment and Climate Action for the period of 2021-2027. The general objectives of the LIFE Programme: (a) to contribute to a just transition towards a sustainable, circular, energy- efficient, renewable energy-based, climate-neutral and -resilient economy, to the protection, restoration and improvement of the quality of the environment, including the air, water and soil, and of health, and to halting and reversing biodiversity loss, including by supporting the implementation and management of the Natura 2000 network and tackling the degradation of ecosystems; (b) to improve the development, implementation, monitoring and enforcement of EU environmental and climate change policy and legislation, and to act as a catalyst for, and promote the integration and mainstreaming of environmental and climate objectives into other European Union policies and public and private sector practices; (c) to improve governance at all levels, in particular by enhancing the capacities of public and private actors and the involvement of civil society; (d) to support the implementation of the 7th Environment Action Programme and any subsequent Union environment action programme. The progress of the LIFE Programme will be monitored and reported regularly by the Commission towards the achievement of the objectives based on the indicators set out in Annex II. The Commission shall be assisted by the Committee for the LIFE Programme.

Policy: Decreto Nº 35/2021 - De la Comercialización de Productos Agropecuarios.
Policy_Content: El presente Decreto tiene por objeto establecer las regulaciones sobre el proceso de comercialización mayorista y minorista de productos agropecuarios. El Decreto se aplica a las personas naturales y jurídicas que participan en la producción, acopio, beneficio, procesamiento, distribución y comercialización de productos agropecuarios. Son objetivos específicos: a) Flexibilizar la comercialización de productos agropecuarios para los diferentes destinos; b) Sustentar la comercialización de productos agropecuarios con un enfoque de cadena de valor; c) Introducir incentivos para la producción, el acopio y la comercialización de productos agropecuarios que repercutan en el incremento de la producción; d) Implementar para el abastecimiento al consumo social, los comités de compras públicas, con el uso de las licitaciones y el establecimiento de un sistema de evaluación de los proveedores; e) Elevar el valor agregado de los productos agropecuarios que se ofertan, el uso de un sistema marcario y de unidades de medidas, la variedad de empaque y calidades en cumplimiento de las normas que garanticen la inocuidad de los productos; f) Mantener una actualización y divulgación semanal de los precios, en correspondencia con los costos y el comportamiento del mercado; y g) Crear mercados de nuevo tipo que impacten con una nueva imagen, limpieza, organización, variedad de ofertas y servicios.

Policy: Regulation of the Minister of Trade no. 27 of 2021 concerning Determination of Export Benchmark Prices for Agricultural and Forestry Products Subject to Export Duty.
Policy_Content: This Ministerial Regulation, implementing provisions of article 2 paragraph (2) of the Regulation of Minister of Trade no. 36/M-DAG/PER/5/2012 concerning Procedures for Determination the Standards of Export Prices for Agricultural and Forestry Products subject to Export Duty, in its last amended version, provides for the determination of the export benchmark price for agricultural and forestry products subject to export duty, taking into account the written proposal and the outcomes of meetings with the relevant technical governmental agencies. Policy: Anti-Corruption and Public Funds Recovery Commission Law of 2021.
Policy_Content: This Law, consisting of 42 articles structured across eight Chapters, is designed to combat corruption in Sudan comprehensively, with a detailed description of various forms of corruption provided in Article 5. The Commission's primary functions encompass (i) formulating national anti-corruption policies, plans, and strategies. Monitoring the enactment of anti-corruption legislation; (ii) receiving and verifying complaints, gathering information, and initiating appropriate actions; (iii) conducting regular investigations.; (iv) disseminating an anti-corruption ethos to the public, emphasizing the significance of safeguarding public funds and assets for effective governance. The main bodies of the Commission are (i) the General Secretariat and (ii) the Investigation Unit.

Policy: Order No. 270 of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources validating the Regulation on the functional subsystem of guardianship and protection of forests of the unified state system of civil protection.
Policy_Content: This Regulation establishes the basis for the functional subsystem of guardianship and protection of forests of the unified state system of civil protection. The objectives of creating a functional subsystem are: (a) protection of the population and forests from emergency situations in peacetime and in a special period, reduction of material losses in case of their occurrence, coordination of measures related to the safe functioning of enterprises, institutions and organizations belonging to the sphere of management of the State Forestry Agency; (b) organization and implementation of civil protection measures related to forest protection; and (c) protection of employees of enterprises, institutions and organizations in the event of an emergency. The tasks of the functional subsystem are: (a)  implementation of civil protection measures at enterprises, institutions and organizations; (b) ensuring the readiness of forces and means of enterprises, institutions and organizations for actions aimed at preventing the occurrence of and response to emergencies, implementation of measures to prevent the occurrence of emergencies or dangerous events; (c) organization and implementation of monitoring and forecasting the occurrence of emergency situations and their development, determining the risks of occurrence of emergency situations at enterprises, institutions and organizations; (d) timely and reliable informing of the interested bodies of the executive power and the population about the risk or occurrence of an emergency at enterprises, institutions and organizations; (e) carrying out rescue and other urgent works to eliminate the consequences of an emergency; (f) ensuring the planning of civil protection measures; (g) organization and conduct of exercises (training) of the management bodies of the functional subsystem and civil protection forces subordinated thereto; (h)  development and implementation of measures aimed at ensuring the stable functioning of enterprises, institutions and organizations in a special period; (i) training of the population, personnel of enterprises, institutions and organizations regarding response and actions in the event of an emergency; (j) implementation of measures to shelter employees of enterprises, institutions and organizations in protective structures of civil protection; (k) development and implementation of programs and plans aimed at preventing natural disasters in forests and plans for civil protection; (l) creation, rational preservation and use of departmental material reserves necessary for prevention and response to emergencies at enterprises, institutions and organizations; and (m) carrying out, within the limits of the powers provided for by law, together with other bodies of the executive power, measures to counter risks and respond to emergencies related to fires in ecosystems.

Policy: Law on energy efficiency and rational use of energy.
Policy_Content: This Law regulates the conditions and manner of efficient use of energy and energy sources; energy efficiency policy; energy management system; energy efficiency policy measures: use of energy in buildings, in energy activities and end customers, for energy facilities and energy services; energy labelling and eco-design requirements; financing, incentives and other measures in this area; establishment and activities of the Directorate for financing and encouragement of energy efficiency, as well as other issues of importance for the rights and obligations of individuals and legal entities related to energy efficiency. The aim of this Law is to create conditions for efficient use of energy and improvement of energy efficiency, which contributes to: 1) achieving energy savings; 2) security of energy supply; 3) reducing the impact of energy sector on the environment and climate change; 4) sustainable use of natural and other resources; 5) increasing the competitiveness of the economy; 6) improving the conditions for economic development; 7) reduction of energy poverty. Energy efficiency and rational use of energy is in the public interest of the Republic of Serbia and of special importance for the Republic of Serbia, except when it comes to protected areas and areas of the ecological network. In order to reduce the negative impact on the environment, to limit greenhouse gas emissions, it is forbidden to burn tires, plastics, waste, as well as fuels derived from waste for heating or business activities, in households, residential buildings and business facilities, except in cases and in the manner prescribed by laws in the field of environmental protection. The Ministry regulates, organizes, implements and monitors the functioning of energy management system and the realization of indicated goals (article 12). The Minister shall prescribe in detail the minimum criteria for conducting the energy audit. The categories of energy audits are: 1) energy audit for the field of industrial energy; 2) energy audit for the field of building energy; 3) energy audit for the field of public sector energy. The subject of financing efficient energy use is the application of energy efficiency measures, as well as activities in the field of efficient energy use that are financed or co-financed in accordance with this Law. Tasks and activities related to the implementation of designated measures are regarding the: 1) application of measures for the purpose of efficient use of energy in the sectors of production, transmission, distribution and consumption of energy; 2) encouraging the development of energy management systems; 3) promotion and implementation of energy audits of facilities/buildings, production processes and services; 4) encouraging the use of micro-cogeneration units, if no other incentives have been realized on the basis of the same micro-cogeneration units in accordance with this Law; 5) encouraging the development of energy services on the market of the Republic of Serbia; 6) encouraging the production of electricity and heat from renewable sources for own needs; 7) raising awareness of the importance and effects of implementing energy efficiency measures; 8) other activities aimed at more efficient use of energy in general.

Policy: Décret n° 061-2021 du 21 Avril 2021/P.M/ portant réaménagement du cadre national de concertation sur la sécurité alimentaire et instituant un Dispositif National de Prévention et de Réponse aux Crises Alimentaires et Nutritionnelles (DCAN).
Policy_Content: L'objet de ce décret, organisé en cinq Titres, est identifié par le premier Titre: le réaménagement du cadre national de concertation sur la sécurité alimentaire et l'institution d'un Dispositif National de Prévention et de Réponse aux Crises Alimentaires et Nutritionnelles (DCAN) comprenant des instances de concertation à compétence générale, des instances de concertation spécialisées et des instances de concertation décentralisées. Le instances de concertation à compétence générale, leur composition et leur fonctionnement sont détaillés par le deuxième Titre qui, divisé en deux chapitres, s'occupe du Comité de Programmation Alimentaire (CPA) (chapitre 1) et du Comité Technique Permanent de Sécurité Alimentaire et de Nutrition (CTP)(chapitre 2). Le troisième Titre, aussi divisé en deux chapitres, est dédié aux instances de concertation spécialisées, notamment les Comités Techniques et les Groupes de Travail chargés, à titre permanent et pour le compte du CPA et du CTP, du système de veille et d'évaluation des besoins, ainsi que de la coordination et du suivi de la mise en oeuvre de la réponse. En particulier, le premier chapitre réglemente le Comité d’Analyse des Besoins (CAB) qui coordonne l'activité de quatre Groupes Techniques Spécialisés (GTS) auxquels sont dédiées les quatre sections qui suivent qui s'occupent de définir les fonctions, la composition et le fonctionnement, respectivement, du Groupe de Travail Spécialisé Chargé du Suivi de la Campagne Agro-pastorale, du Groupe de Travail Spécialisé Chargé de la Vulnérabilité, du Groupe de Travail Spécialisé Chargé du Suivi des Marchés alimentaires et des Approvisionnements et du Groupe de Travail Spécialisé Chargé de la Nutrition. Le deuxième chapitre réglemente, par contre, le Comité de Coordination de la Mise en oeuvre de la Réponse (CCMR) qui coordonne l'activité de quatre Comités Techniques Spécialisés (CTS), qui font l'objet de quatre sections dédiées: le Comité de Travail Spécialisé Chargé des Filets Sociaux, le Comité de Travail Spécialisé Chargé des Moyens d’Existence, le Comité de Travail Spécialisé Chargé de l’Assistance Alimentaire, le Comité de Travail Spécialisé Chargé de la Nutrition. Le quatrième Titre s'occupe des instance de concertation décentralisées: il est créé au niveau de chaque Wilaya un Comité Régional de Suivi de la Sécurité Alimentaire et Nutritionnelle (CRSAN) qui assure la concertation dans ce domaine. Suivent, dans le cinquième Titre, des dispositions finales.

Policy: Order No. 258 of the Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources validating the Regulation on the “Shatsky” national natural park.
Policy_Content: “Shatsky” national natural park is budgetary, non-profit, nature conservation, recreational, cultural-educational, scientific-research institution and is classified as part of the nature reserve fund of Ukraine, protected as national property for which a special regime of protection, reproduction and management is established. Management of the park is entrusted to the State Agency of Forestry Resources. The national natural park was created with the aim of preserving, reproducing and rationally using the unique forest natural complexes of Shatsky Lake, which have a special nature protection, health, historical-cultural, scientific, ecological-educational and aesthetic value, strengthening the protection of wetlands of international significance and promoting the development of international cooperation in the field of conservation of biological and landscape diversity. The main tasks of the park are: (a) protection and preservation of valuable natural and historical-cultural complexes and objects; (b) protection of the conditions of reproduction, restoration of numbers, preservation of the gene pool of rare and typical plants and animals; (c) creation of conditions for organized tourism, rest and other types of recreational activities in natural conditions with observance of the regime of protection of protected natural complexes and objects; (d) carrying out scientific studies of natural complexes and their changes in the conditions of recreational use, developing scientific recommendations on environmental protection and effective use of natural resources on its territory; (e) implementation of control over compliance by other land users (land owners) and citizens within the “Shatsky” national natural park with the requirements of the legislation, this Regulation and the Territory Organization Project; and (f) environmental and educational work. The following is prohibited within the territory of the park: (a) in the period of mass reproduction of mass reproduction of wild fauna species, from 1 April to 15 June carrying out works and activities that are a source of increased noise and disturbance (firing, carrying out explosive works, fireworks, sanitary felling of the forest, holding rally and other competitions on vehicles); and (b) demolition or otherwise damaging, elimination of natural habitats of wild animals (burrows, lairs, nests, etc.).

The Law also deals with the single window, to coordinate the different concerned ministries am=nd bodies (art.9). The Ministry every 5 years shall develop an Investment National Strategy in coordination with the concerned parties (art.15). Several tax exemptions are introduced by article 20, including customs, business profits tax, and VAT, among others, until the end of the capital recovery period for projects that achieve an economic benefit. Article 25 establishes the creation of an Investment Register that will gather all investing entities’ data and store it in modern and secure systems. Article 26 provides for the issuance of an investment procedural guide which includes all the conditions, procedures, timeframes prescribed for land allocation, issuance of approvals, permits, and licenses about investment activities to clarify and facilitate procedures for all investors. This guide will be accessible online and will be updated periodically. While a specialized insurance company, envisaged by article 27, will ensure investors against different risks (e.g., risks of nationalization, risks of war, domestic conflict and civil disobedience, risks of recession, etc.) for an annual premium.

Policy: Preliminary National Standard of the Russian Federation PNST 540⎯2021 Biological control agents for organic agriculture. General specifications.

The manufacturing of biological control agents for organic agriculture must comply with the requirements of the acting regulatory legal acts. The priority source of source material for the propagation of biological control agents for organic agriculture, with a sufficient level of quality, is native flora and fauna. Production of biological control agents for organic agriculture using genetic engineering methods, genetically modified organisms is prohibited. Biological control agents for organic agriculture and the processes associated with their use must comply with the requirements of and must be included in the catalog as microbiological and biological pesticides that have passed state registration in accordance with the established procedure. The use of ionizing radiation is prohibited. The production of biological control agents for organic agriculture should be separated from the production of other biological and chemical plant protection products that do not meet the requirements for organic production. Microorganisms used in organic agriculture must be deposited with an organization authorized in the relevant field and identified by sequencing to the species.

The Code specifies that who carry on activities relating to agriculture, forestry, plant nursery, cattle breeding or maintaining pasture land, shall not be deemed to be traders where they sell the products of the land they exploit or use, or animals or the products of animals bred mainly from the resources of the land.

Policy: Legislative Decree 8/2021 regarding the Consumer Protection Law.
Policy_Content: This Law consisting of 83 articles divided into VIII Chapters aims at (i) protecting the rights of the consumer; (ii) ensuring the safety of food; (iii) preventing monopoly through setting regulations for trade practicing, pricing, imposing censorship on the quality of goods and products. It also tightens penalties and fines on monopoly, selling without an invoice, not announcing prices, and manipulating with weight, as well as selling at increasing prices. Article 3 lists the consumers' rights as follows (i) obtaining the product according to its intended purpose; (ii) health and safety when using or consuming the products provided to him; (iii) knowing the price and all correct information and data about the products; (iv) the freedom to choose the products that meet the quality in conformity with the specifications and the price specified for them; (v) obtaining an invoice proving that he acquired the product; (vi) decent treatment and respect for community customs and traditions; (vii) submit a complaint about the violations stipulated in this Legislative Decree. Article 4 specifies cases in which it is possible or not, to replace or return the products. Article 8 prohibits the supplier to possess or sell any products of unknown origin or spoiled materials. To achieve the objectives of this Legislative Decree, the Ministry of Internal Trade and Consumer Protection shall assume the following powers (i) take the measures to prevent monopoly and tampering with prices of the products; (ii) determine the price, without prejudice to the supplier's right to reduce the price in the interest of the consumer; (iii) oblige the importer to submit customs declarations and all documents required by the ministry; (iv) oblige the importer, producer, and wholesaler to submit a declaration on the basic materials and commodities that he possesses or trades, and these permits are exempt from the stamp duty; (v) monitoring compliance with the advertisement of prices on adherence to economic rules related to legitimate competition, in a manner that secures the consumer’s freedom of choice (art.11).

Policy: Danish Climate Action Plan for Agriculture.
Policy_Content: The present Climate Action Plan for Agriculture sets out the Government's intention to cut carbon dioxide emissions from agriculture by 7.1 million tons by 2030, primarily through increased spending on green farming technologies. Policy: Law No. LP50/2021 “On local initiative groups.”
Policy_Content: The purpose of this Law is to create a legal basis for the establishment and functioning of local initiative groups. This Law regulates the procedure for the establishment, operation, reorganization and liquidation of local initiative groups. Local initiative groups shall be intended unprofitable, non-political association with the status of a legal entity, which is created for the purpose of developing and implementation of local development strategies based on established at the local level between public, business and civil sectors of territorial partnership, in which none of these sectors can own more than 49 percent of voting rights at the decision-making level. Local initiative groups shall be constituted on voluntary basis and have the status of legal entity. The scope of local initiative groups shall be definition of a rural area consisting of adjacent residential areas related by social, economic and natural features, characterized by local identity, common traditions, needs and prospects within which the local development strategy is being implemented, and development and approval of a local development strategy. This Law consists of VI Sections divided into 39 Articles. Section I lays down general provisions. Section II regards membership and establishment. Section III regards governing bodies. Policy: Waste Management (Landfill) (Amendment) Regulations, 2021.(L.N. 147 of 2021)
Policy_Content: These regulations amend the Waste Management (Landfill) Regulations ("the principal regulations")as follows: Sub-regulations (2) of Regulations 1 are substituted so as to better define the objective of the Regulations, which is supporting the European Union’s transition to a circular economy and meeting the requirements of Directive 2008/98/EC, particularly so as to ensure a progressive reduction of landfilling of waste and reduce negative effects on the environment. Also sub-regulations 3 is amended and sub-regulations 4, which is substituted to reflect the amendments in the European legislation as regards specific criteria for the storage of metallic mercury. Regulation 2 is amended so as to introduce some new definitions. Regulations 3 is also modified: in particular a sub-regulation 3 is added here in order to exclude the management of waste from land-based extractive industries from the scope of these regulations. Regulation 5 is also amended: a new sub-regulation 3 is added foreseeing, by 2035, the reduction of the amount of municipal waste landfilled to 10% or less of the total amount of municipal waste generated (by weight). A new sub-regulation 4 is also added to provide for the possibility to postpone the target referred to in sub-regulations  3. Rules on the calculation of the attainment of such targets are set out in a new regulation 5A. In regulation 6, among other, are revised the wastes that are not accepted in a landfill and a sub-regulations 2 is added which requires that the competent authority endeavours to ensure that, as of 2030, all waste suitable for recycling or other recovery, in particular municipal waste, shall not be accepted in a landfill (excepted the waste for which landfilling delivers the best environmental outcome). Further, regulations 10, 11, 12 and 14 are reworded and a new regulation 17A is added after regulation 17, referring to economic instruments and other measures to provide incentives for the application of the waste hierarchy under regulation 4A of the Waste Regulations. Also Schedules 1, 2 and 3 are amended.

Policy: Waste (Amendment) Regulations, 2021. (L.N. 146 of 2021).
Policy_Content: These Regulations, to be read and construed together with the Waste Regulations, 2011 (principal regulations) amend several of its provisions. Sub-regulation (2) of regulations 2, concerning the objective of the regulations is reworded stressing the accent on the importance of the transition to a circular economy and the European Union’s long-term competitiveness. Sub regulation (3)is amended to reflect the changes in European legislation. In regulation 3, among other amendments, a new paragraph (e) is added to mention substances that are destined for use as feed materials. Regulation 4 is reviewed to introduce, amend or delete some definitions: Agency, agreement, backfilling, best available techniques, bio-waste, community, construction and demolition waste, A new regulation 4A is added to introduce and apply a waste hierarchy, described thereof, to encourage the best overall environmental outcome according to the principles of self sufficiency and proximity. Regulation 5 is substituted to guarantee, upon certain conditions, that a substance resulting from a production process isconsidered not to be waste, but to be a by-product. Regulation 6 is also substituted to recognize that waste which has undergone a recycling or other recovery operation is considered to have ceased to be waste if it complies with the following conditions. Regulation 7 is substituted concerning the classification as hazardous waste to that displaying one or more of the properties listed in Schedule 3. Regulation 8 is deleted and so is Sub-regulation (2) of regulation 9. Regulation 10 on separate collection is substituted and new regulations 10A, 10B, 10C and 10D are added to, respectively, foresee the adoption of measures to prevent waste generation; ensure that waste undergoes preparing for re-use, recycling or other recovery operations; to promote preparing for re-use activities trough economic instruments, procurement criteria, quantitative objectives and targets or other measures; to calculate whether the targets laid down in regulation 10C. Regulation 12 is amended and sub-regulation (7) is reworded to reflect the Extended Producer Responsibility Framework Regulations, 2021, in accordance with the polluter pays principle. Regulation 16 is amended to provide that Where hazardous waste has been unlawfully mixed in breach of this regulation, separation is carried out where technically feasible or treated in a facility that has obtained a permit. Regulation 18 concerning waste oils is reworded and a regulation 19A concerning bio-waste is introduced. Regulations 19, 23 are reworded and also regulation 28 concerning the establishment of one or more waste management plans. Regulation 29 and (2) is amended to provide for the Minister to establish waste prevention programmes setting out the waste prevention measures laid down in regulation 10A and for the competent authority and the Agency to describe the contribution of instruments and measures listed in Annex IVa to Directive 2008/98/EC. A new regulation 33A providing for annual reporting activities by the establishments and undertakings which act as dealers and brokers of waste is introduced. Regulation 34 concerning measures to prohibit the abandonment, dumping or uncontrolled management of waste, including littering is reworded. Schedules 2,3 and 5 are amended; schedule 7 is deleted and a new schedule 10 substitutes the previous one.

Policy: Governmental Decision No. 489-N regulating transportation and transfer of hazardous waste in the process of trade between member states of Eurasian Economic Union and validating the procedure for issuance of license (permit) for transportation and transfer of hazardous waste.

Transboundary transfer of hazardous waste for waste disposal and (or) treatment (neutralization) thereof shall be prohibited. Policy: Presidential Decree No. 137 validating the Regulation on licensing of activities in the field of the use of nuclear energy and sources of ionizing radiation.
Policy_Content: This Presidential Decree regulates relations in the field of the use of nuclear energy and sources of ionizing radiation. It shall not be applicable to the use of ionizing radiation for military activities. Licensing of activities in the field of nuclear energy and sources of ionizing radiation shall be intended a complex of measures implemented by the state related to the issuance of licenses, their duplicates, modification thereof, extension of terms, suspension, renewal, termination, revocation of licenses, control over compliance by licensees of licensing terms and conditions when carrying out activities in the field of the use of nuclear energy and sources of ionizing radiation in conformity with licensing legislation, licensing requirements and conditions. Licensing body is the Ministry of Emergency Situations. Licensing of activities in the field of nuclear energy and sources of ionizing radiation are carried out on the principles of: (a) the priority of protecting human life and health, environment and state security; (b) equality of rights of subjects of economic activity; (c) determination of exhaustive lists of pre-licensing requirements and conditions, license requirements and conditions; (d) independence of the licensing authority and Gosatomnadzor in the adoption of decisions on licensing issues and in exercising control over compliance by licensees with legislation on licensing, licensing requirements and conditions, including special license requirements and conditions; (e) inadmissibility of charging fees from license applicants (licensees) for the implementation of licensing (with the exception of payment of state fees in the cases and in the manner prescribed by law, paying a fee for conducting a safety review in accordance with the procedure stipulated by the agreement on its implementation, as well as compensation expenses for conducting a safety review, transferred to the national budget); and (f) openness and accessibility of information on the procedure for licensing, pre-licensing requirements and conditions, license requirements and conditions, as well as licensees.

Policy: Governmental Decree No. 127 validating the Regulation on ecological corridors.
Policy_Content: Regulation on ecological corridors governs creation of ecological corridors, establishing regimes for their protection and use of land included therein. Ecological corridor shall be intended part of ecological networks, represented by protected areas of land and waterbodies connecting protected natural territories among themselves for securing natural migrations (distribution) of wild fauna and wild flora species and conservation of biological diversity. Ecological barriers shall be intended natural, natural and technogenic elements/objects (high mountain systems, landscapes, canals, transport routes), representing obstacles to movement of wild fauna species and spreading of wild flora species, biogeochemical and biogeocenotic regulation. Ecological corridors can be natural or artificial (man-made). Ecological corridors are created for the purpose of ensuring spatially genetic unity and integrity of populations, conservation of natural complexes, biological and landscape diversity thereof, ensuring protection and reproduction of economically valuable, as well as rare and endangered wild fauna and wild flora species, natural migration routes of wild fauna species and spreading of wild flora species. Creation of an ecological corridor is aimed at performance of the following main tasks: (a) preservation of the main landscape, protective, forage and other conditions, favorable for certain species of biological diversity, including those listed in the Red Book of the Kyrgyz Republic providing their feeding, reproduction and migrations/spreading; (b) maintaining spatially genetic unity and connectedness to ecosystems, preventing their fragmentation; and (c) promoting conservation of wild fauna and wild flora species composition, maintaining and increasing number thereof, improving conditions of their habitat/growth, and migration/distribution.

Policy: Regulation on the State Institution "Center for Public-Private Partnership" under the Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic.
Policy_Content: This Regulation defines the legal and organizational framework of the State Institution "Center for Public-Private Partnership" under the Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic. The PPP Center is a state executive body of the Kyrgyz Republic, functioning in the status of a subordinate subdivision of the Ministry of Economy and Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic in the form of a state institution carrying out management functions to promote public-private partnership mechanisms. The PPP Center operates in cooperation with government agencies and local government, representatives of the business community, foreign investors, international organizations, as well as other legal entities and natural persons. The purpose of the PPP Center is to develop mechanisms of public-private partnership by promoting PPP projects, improving state and municipal infrastructure and services in the Kyrgyz Republic through attracting investment and management experience from the private sector with the use of PPP mechanisms. The tasks of the PPP Center shall be to coordinate projects of public-private partnerships and the dissemination of PPP mechanisms in various socially significant sectors of the Kyrgyz Republic through the formation of the necessary PPP project management systems, including assistance to government partners in the search, initiation, preparation, implementation and monitoring of the implementation of PPP projects.

The Regulation defines free trade zone; prohibition from exporting goods of the following sectors: agriculture, including fertilisers; forestry, including wood types and species of trees; mining, waste, cultural heritage; prohibition from importing goods of the following sectors: food and nutrition, particularly sugar, rice; hazardous and toxic waste; non hazardous and toxic waste; medical devices containing mercury; hand tools in finished form; ozone depleting substances; used plastic bags, sacks and clothes; goods using refrigeration systems based on chlorofluorocarbon and hydrofluorocarbon. The Regulation defines conditions for re-import of prohibited goods, and for the return of exported goods, outside the customs area and the special economic zones, and provides for sanctions in accordance with the provisions of the legislation, in case of violation of its provisions. The attached schedules detail the various goods whose export or import is prohibited for each specific sector.

Policy: Decreto Supremo Nº 063-2021-PCM - Decreto Supremo que aprueba el Reglamento que desarrolla el Marco Institucional que rige el Proceso de Mejora de la Calidad Regulatoria y establece los Lineamientos Generales para la aplicación del Análisis de Impacto Regulatorio Ex Ante.
Policy_Content: El presente Decreto Supremo aprueba el “Reglamento que desarrolla el Marco Institucional que rige el Proceso de Mejora de la Calidad Regulatoria y establece los Lineamientos Generales para la aplicación del Análisis de Impacto Regulatorio Ex Ante”, el cual tiene por objeto desarrollar el marco institucional que rige el proceso de Mejora de la Calidad Regulatoria. Asimismo, establece los lineamientos generales para la aplicación del Análisis de Impacto Regulatorio Ex Ante y de otros instrumentos que aseguren la idoneidad y la calidad del contenido de las intervenciones regulatorias. El Análisis de Impacto Regulatorio Ex Ante se define como un proceso que permite el análisis previo, sistemático e integral para identificar, evaluar y medir los probables resultados, beneficios y costos de distintas alternativas de solución (regulatorias y no regulatorias) de un problema público, considerando la identificación y el análisis de riesgos, con el fin de adoptar la mejor alternativa de intervención en base a evidencia. Se crea la Comisión Multisectorial de Calidad Regulatoria, la que tiene como objeto evaluar el AIR Ex Ante de los proyectos regulatorios que presenten las entidades públicas del Poder Ejecutivo en el marco de lo dispuesto en el artículo 10 del presente Reglamento.

Policy_Content: El presente Decreto crea la Comisión de Fomento a la Tecnificación del Sistema Nacional de Riego para coordinar la elaboración y ejecución de la Estrategia Nacional de Tecnificación de los Sistemas de Riego. El propósito de la Estrategia Nacional de Tecnificación del Sistema de Riego será la racionalización del uso del agua en la actividad agrícola, así como fomentar la incorporación de tecnologías que incrementen la productividad, disminuyan el costo ambiental y permitan que nuevas extensiones de tierra puedan ser agregadas a la producción agrícola intensiva. Se crea la Dirección Ejecutiva de la Comisión de Fomento a la Tecnificación del Sistema Nacional de Riego como órgano ejecutor de dicha comisión para apoyar en la elaboración e implementación de la Estrategia Nacional de Tecnificación del Sistema de Riego y se establecen las funciones de la Dirección Ejecutiva. Policy: DENR Administrative Order No. 2021-05 Revised Regulations Governing the Establishment and Operations of Wood Processing Plants (WPPS).
Policy_Content: This Order is drafted in light of governmental policies to rationalize the wood industry by regulating, among others, the establishment, location and operation of wood processing plants in the country. The Order provides for conditions to apply for a Wood Processing Plant Permit and renewal of the application for local wood raw materials and imported wood materials. The permit shall be issued by the Undersecretary for Field Operations. All WPP holders shall submit corresponding reports to concerned DENR Regional Offices while failure to submit the report and requirements on time, and any violation of the terms and conditions of the permit will result to the suspension or cancellation of the permit and/or confiscation of the bond. The Order further provides for proper disposal of sawmill and milling waste materials that shall not be dumped into rivers and streams or in any place which shall cause pollution or unsightly appearance of the vicinity. Monitoring of the milling operations of the company shall be conducted by concerned DENR field offices to ensure compliance with forestry laws, rules and regulations. This Order consists of 20 Articles divided into 7 Chapters. The text has one Annex and a sample permit/template.

Policy: Decision on declaring fossils of dinosaurs and their sites as protected parts of nature.
Policy_Content: This Decision, as in accordance with the provisions of the national Law on nature protection, established that dinosaur fossils, present on 24 (twenty-four) sites located on the territory of the Republic of Croatia, are significant due to their rarity, size, appearance, educational and scientific significance, and are declared protected parts of nature. It is forbidden to destroy protected dinosaur fossils and to carry out interventions and/or actions that may lead to damage to such protected dinosaur fossils and related sites. Protected dinosaur fossils are kept at the site of their original finding (in situ), and if it is not possible to protect them at the site, with the permission of the ministry responsible for nature protection, they are given for safekeeping to a legal or natural person who will provide their professional protection (ex situ protection or conservation). Protected dinosaur fossils and their sites are managed by locally competent public institutions for the management of protected areas and/or other protected parts of nature.

Policy: Agriculture Act No. 4 of 2021.
Policy_Content: This Act lays down rules for the purposes of (a) providing for the development of sustainable agricultural practices, (b) collecting data in relation to agriculture, (c) regulating the agriculture industry, (d) providing for inspectors and specify their powers and the procedures they must follow, (e) enabling the regulatory regime in this Act to apply throughout the Cook Islands, and (f) enabling the establishment of specific advisory committees to assist with the carrying out of functions under this Act. This Act sets out provisions on the functions and responsibilities of the Ministry and its committees; data collection to measure agricultural production, identify or measure a risk to agricultural production, take informed responses to invasive species outbreaks or other plant or animal emergencies; the appointment of data collectors; the appointment and powers of the inspectors to carry out their functions in accordance with the provisions of the Pesticides Act and the Biosecurity Act; and offences and penalties and their prosecution. Other acts administered by the Ministry are set out in Schedule 1 and the amendments to other Acts are set out in Schedule 2, which are annexed to this Act. The functions of the Ministry include but not limited to: (I) encouraging sustainable agricultural production, such as the production of crops, livestock, and pollinators, managing crop and livestock genetic resources, and protecting the welfare of livestock and other farmed animals; (II) regulating agricultural health and improving the biosecurity status of the Cook Islands in accordance with the Biosecurity Act; (III) regulating pesticides in accordance with the Pesticides Act; (IV) supporting the relevant ministry with responsibility for food safety legislation, initiatives, and policy; (V) undertaking agricultural research and development; (VI) developing plans, policies, and strategies for the agricultural sector at the national and islands levels; (VII) supporting the marketing and use of agricultural inputs, including pesticides, crop seeds, fertilizers and veterinary drugs; (VIII) developing quality certification schemes and value chains for the agricultural sector; (IX) supporting stakeholders' participation in agriculture; (X) managing forestry and promoting afforestation and reforestation; (XI) providing advisory and extension services and institutional capacity development; (XII) facilitating access to finance and investment and partnerships in the agricultural sector; (XIII) facilitating access to domestic and overseas markets for agricultural products; (XIV) monitoring and assessing the agricultural sector, including through the collection, assessment, and reporting of agricultural data and statistics.

Policy: Decree on the sustainability criteria for biofuels and greenhouse gas emissions.
Policy_Content: This Decree, based on the provisions of the Slovenian Environmental protection Act, determines sustainability and greenhouse gas emission saving criteria for biofuels, bioliquids for energy purposes and biomass fuels, by providing: obligation to reduce greenhouse gas emissions over the life cycle of fuels used in transport; sustainability criteria for biofuels; verification of compliance with sustainability criteria for biofuels and issuance of accompanying certificates; use of a system of mass balance of raw materials or biofuels, and biomass fuels used in transport, with different sustainability criteria in the joint supply; methodology for calculating and saving greenhouse gas emissions over the life cycle of fuels used in transport; obligation for annual suppliers of fuels to report on the emission intensity and amount of greenhouse gas emissions from fuels and energy used in transport. This text is in accordance with several EU legislative documents as listed in article 1. The Annex (1-7) is also part of this publication (containing Rules for calculating the impact of biofuels, biofuels for energy purposes and their comparative values for fossil fuels on greenhouse gases; Rules for calculating the impact of biomass fuels and their comparative values for fossil fuels on greenhouse gases; Advanced fuels; Method for calculating the total life cycle greenhouse gas intensity of fuels and energy for fuel suppliers; Typical and default values of greenhouse gas savings over the life cycle of biofuels; Energy values of biofuels and fuels; Greenhouse gas emissions due to indirect land use change).

Chapter 6 sets conditions and requirements for grant of wood export licence. Elle ne s'applique pas aux produits chimiques et à leurs déchets suivants : 1° les produits chimiques utilisés à des fins militaires, de défense nationale, de sécurité publique ou de recherches ; 2° les produits chimiques utilisés : -soit dans les médicaments, les produits cosmétiques et d'hygiène corporelle, les matériaux au contact des denrées alimentaires, les produits servant au nettoyage de ceux-ci, les produits antiparasitaires à usage agricole et assimilés, les matières fertilisantes et supports de culture et les explosifs ; - soit à titre d'additifs ou d'auxiliaires technologiques dans les aliments et, d'une manière générale, aux substances qui font l'objet d'une autre procédure de déclaration, d'homologation ou d'autorisation préalable à la mise sur le marché, visant à protéger l'homme et son environnement; 3° les pesticides à usage agricole ; 4° les substances radioactives ; 5° les biocides.

Policy: Decreto Ejecutivo Nº 42742 - Creación y regulación de la categoría de manejo denominada Parques Naturales Urbanos (PANU), y de un Programa Nacional para su promoción e implementación".
Policy_Content: El presente Decreto Ejecutivo crea una nueva categoría de manejo de Área Silvestre Protegida (ASP) denominada Parques Naturales Urbanos (PANU). Los Parques Naturales Urbanos son áreas geográficas ubicadas dentro de zonas urbanas, que poseen ecosistemas terrestres y costeros de valor escénico, biológico, recreativo y ecoturístico, cuya importancia radica en la necesidad de proteger y conservar su biodiversidad. Los objetivos de estos parques son: a) preservación de ecosistemas naturales remanentes, especialmente aquellos poco representados en otras categorías de manejo; b) captura de carbono; c) recreación y ecoturismo; d) propiciar conectividad biológica con la trama verde de la ciudad, así como con ríos urbanos; e) restauración, conservación y mantenimiento de los servicios ecosistémicos para el disfrute de habitantes y visitantes; f) investigación científica de la biodiversidad y ecosistemas premontanos; g) investigación científica para la adaptación de las ciudades a los efectos del cambio climático; h) prevención del riesgo de desastres naturales en zonas urbanas; i) dinamizar la economía local mediante la promoción de actividades productivas de bajo impacto, enmarcadas dentro de la economía verde, que promuevan la conservación, la primacía de la biodiversidad y el desarrollo local. Las actividades permitidas y no permitidas se definirán en el Plan General de Manejo del PANU.

Policy: Order No. 188 of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources validating the Regulation on National Natural Park “Beloozersky”.
Policy_Content: The National Natural Park “Beloozersky” is located on the territory of Boryspil district of Kyiv region and Cherkasy district of Cherkasy region. The park is a budgetary, non-profit, nature conservation, recreational, cultural and educational, scientific research institution and is part of the nature reserve fund of Ukraine, protected as a national property, with a special regime of protection, reproduction and management. On the territory of the park, the necessary state information and security signs of the approved model, in particular landmarks, are installed in designated places. The Park lands are fenced if necessary. The park was created with the aim of improving the management of preservation, reproduction and recreational use of typical and unique natural complexes that have an important nature conservation, scientific, aesthetic, recreational and health-improving value, preservation and reproduction of the gene pool of the plant and animal world and their rational use in scientific, nature conservation, economic and recreational purposes. The main tasks of the park are: (a) preservation and reproduction of valuable natural complexes and historical and cultural objects located on its territory, wild fauna and wild flora species; (b) creation of conditions for organized tourism and other types of recreational activities in natural conditions with observance of the regime of protection of protected complexes and objects; (c) conducting scientific research, including the study of natural complexes and their changes in the conditions of recreational use, development of scientific recommendations on environmental protection and rational use of natural resources; (d) ensuring the protection of its territory with all natural objects; (e) preservation of the gene pool of rare, listed in the Red Book of Ukraine, and typical plants, animals, birds, fishes and invertebrates; (f) study of ecosystem changes under the influence of natural and anthropogenic factors; (g) maintenance of the general ecological balance in the region; and (h) carrying out environmental educational work.

Policy: Order No. 190 of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources validating the Regulation on National Natural Park “Synogora”.
Policy_Content: The National Natural Park “Synogora” is located on the territory of Ivano-Frankivsk district of the Ivano-Frankivsk region. The park is a budgetary, non-profit, nature conservation, recreational, cultural and educational, scientific research institution and is part of the nature reserve fund of Ukraine, protected as a national property, with a special regime of protection, reproduction and management. The Park lands are fenced if necessary. The park was created for the purpose of preservation, reproduction and rational use of typical and unique natural complexes of the Carpathian region, which have important environmental, scientific, aesthetic, recreational and healthcare benefits. The main tasks of the park are: (a) preservation and reproduction of valuable natural complexes and historical and cultural objects located on its territory, wild fauna and wild flora species; (b) creation of conditions for organized tourism and other types of recreational activities in natural conditions with observance of the regime of protection of protected complexes and objects; (c) conducting scientific research, including the study of natural complexes and their changes in the conditions of recreational use, development of scientific recommendations on environmental protection and rational use of natural resources; (d) ensuring the protection of its territory with all natural objects; (e) preservation of the gene pool of rare, listed in the Red Book of Ukraine, and typical plants, animals, birds, fishes and invertebrates; (f) study of ecosystem changes under the influence of natural and anthropogenic factors; (g) maintenance of the general ecological balance in the region; and (h) carrying out environmental educational work.

Policy: Agricultural Workers Regulation No.19 of 2021.
Policy_Content: This Regulation consisting of 17 articles aims to regulate the operations of the workforce sector, preserve workers' rights without discrimination, and ensure their coverage under the social insurance per the Social Security Law in place. Article 3 establishes that (i) the agricultural work contract is considered for a fixed term if it is agreed between the worker and the agricultural employer to work for a specific period or season. Otherwise, the agricultural work contract is considered to be of unlimited duration; (ii) the agricultural worker may prove his rights by all legal methods of proof if the contract is not drawn up in writing. Article 4 establishes working hours, rest hours, extra hours in case of emergency. The agricultural worker is entitled to a weekly day off according to the nature of agricultural work (art.5). Agricultural work is prohibited under 16 years of age, while the age of 18 must be completed for agricultural work that is dangerous, exhausting, or harmful to health, and these jobs are determined by a decision issued by the Minister (art.6). Article 7 deals with annual leave. Article 8 provides for (i) the wage of an agricultural worker, that may not be less than the minimum wage specified in accordance with the law; (ii) payment of the wage and prohibition of deductions except in cases permitted by law; and (iii) duty of equal wages for agricultural workers for every work of equal value without any discrimination based on sex. As for article 9 the agricultural business owner is obligated and at his expense to provide suitable housing for agricultural workers and appropriate facilities in the event that the nature of the agricultural work requires that or the agricultural work contract includes this condition. An agricultural business owner who employs at least twenty agricultural workers is obligated to establish an internal system that indicates working hours, daily rest periods, holidays, vacations, work violations, penalties (including dismissal from work and its implementation). The internal system is subject to the approval of the Minister (art.10).

Policy: Regulation No. 681 on hunting, killing, trapping, and fishing in state commons.
Policy_Content: The purpose of the present Regulation is to ensure that wildlife and fish in state commons is managed in a way that ensures the conservation of biodiversity. Within this framework, these resources shall develop in a way that safeguards the rights under the Mountain Act, promoting local businesses, and ensuring public access to hunting, fishing, and outdoor recreation. The regulation shall also ensure that all hunting, killing, trapping, and fishing in state commons is carried out in a manner that is acceptable to the public. As a general rule, individuals who have been and still are permanent residents in Norway shall have the right to hunt, shoot, trap, and fish in state commons. The Regulation contains 23 articles divided into the following chapters: 1. General provisions; 2. Allocation of fishing, small game hunting and trapping; 3. Allocation of big game hunting; 4. Policy: Governmental Decision HG27/2021 validating the Regulation on the establishment of a diesel fuel quantum from external humanitarian aid provided by Romania, intended to support agricultural producers affected by the 2020 drought.
Policy_Content: This Governmental Decree establishes a diesel fuel quantum from external humanitarian aid provided by Romania, intended to support agricultural producers affected by the 2020 drought as a form of partial compensation of damages of agricultural producers due to losses of crops. Assistance shall be provided in case that, according to the acts of ascertaining, 60% or more of crop yields from the 2020 crop were lost due to drought. To receive assistance, the applicant must meet the following conditions: (a) to prove the fact of ownership or cultivation of land plots sown by crops for the harvest of 2020; and (b) the submitted acts of ascertaining must contain reliable data and must be drawn up within the time period established by this Regulation. Governmental Decision contains calculation formula for the establishment of a diesel fuel quantum.

Policy: Governmental Decree No. 87 “On issues of the Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Kyrgyz Republic.”
Policy_Content: Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Kyrgyz Republic is an authorized state executive body of the Kyrgyz Republic implementing a unified state policy in the field of civil protection, fire safety, radiation safety, safety of people on waterbodies, hydrometeorology, ecology and environmental protection, ensuring environmental safety, management of protected natural areas (excluding state natural parks), management of the system of state material reserve, state supervision and control on environmental, fire and radiation security. The scope of the Ministry is to develop and implement unified state environmental policy ensuring the preservation of the ecological system of the Kyrgyz Republic and environmental protection, implementation of state supervision and control over ensuring compliance with the norms and requirements of environmental security and stable functioning of the systems of state material reserve. The Ministry shall perform the following tasks: (a) monitoring and forecasting hazardous natural, technogenic processes and phenomena, planning of activities in the field of civil protection, fire safety, radiation safety, safety of people on waterbodies and hydrometeorology, training of governing bodies, forces of civil protection and the population to act in emergency situations; (b) prevention, implementation of preventive protective measures against emergency situations; (c) organization and holding search and rescue, emergency recovery, other urgent work, elimination of consequences of emergency situations, assessment of their scale; (d) implementation of state policy and regulation in the field of ecology, environmental protection, as well as accounting, assessment of the state of natural components; (e) preventing the impact of possible negative consequences from the implementation, planned management, economic and other activities on the environment; (f) establishment and development of international cooperation of the Kyrgyz Republic in the field of environmental protection, ecological security; (g) state supervision and control over compliance with regulatory requirements of legal acts, technical regulations for fire, environmental, biological, chemical, radiation and nuclear safety in relation to products (objects) and/or related processes of manufacturing, construction, installation, adjustment, operation, storage, transportation, use, trade, burial, placement and disposal; (h) management of material assets of state material reserve; (i) ensuring the fulfillment of tasks established by mobilization plans approved by the Government of the Kyrgyz Republic, as well as mobilization tasks in cases of emergencies, the introduction of a regime of state of emergency and martial law, or wartime mobilization; and (j) organization of dispatch for storage, accumulation, storage, refreshment and release of material assets of the state material reserve.

Policy: Real Decreto Nº 149/2021 - Por el que se regula el programa de ayudas para la realización de actuaciones de eficiencia energética en explotaciones agropecuarias y se acuerda la concesión directa de las ayudas de este programa a las comunidades autónomas.
Policy_Content: Este real decreto tiene por objeto la aprobación del programa de ayudas para la realización de actuaciones de eficiencia energética en explotaciones agropecuarias, regular la concesión directa, con carácter extraordinario, y por razones de interés público, social y económico, de ayudas a las comunidades autónomas, así como su distribución y entrega, en las cuantías y términos que figuran en el anexo III. Asimismo establece las bases reguladoras para la concesión de subvenciones del programa de ayudas para la realización de actuaciones de eficiencia energética en explotaciones agropecuarias a sus destinatarios últimos, cuya finalidad es reducir el consumo de energía final en el sector agrícola para cumplir con los objetivos fijados por el artículo 7 de la Directiva 2012/27/UE. Serán beneficiarias directas de las ayudas previstas en este real decreto las comunidades autónomas relacionadas en el anexo III de este real decreto, que deberán destinar el importe de las mismas a los sujetos que se enumeran en el artículo 11. El programa está dotado con una cuantía inicial de 30.000.000 euros. El artículo 13 establece las actuaciones subvencionables.

Policy: Décret n°2021-0308/PRES/PM/MINEFID/MFPTPS portant statut particulier du métier santé humaine et animale
Policy_Content: Le présent décret porte le statut particulier du métier santé humaine et animale. Le métier « santé humaine et animale » regroupe les familles d'emplois intervenant dans la prévention des maladies, l'amélioration de l'état de santé humaine et animale et de la qualité de la production animale. (IV) la famille d'emplois « laboratoire de biologie médicale » : l'emploi de technologiste biomédical ; l'emploi de biologiste médical ; (V) la famille d'emplois « imagerie médicale » : l'emploi de technicien supérieur en médicale ; l'emploi de nutritionniste ; (IX) la famille d'emplois « technologie d'assistance médicale » : l'emploi de technicien supérieur en technologie d' assistance médicale ; l'emploi d' ingénieur en technologie assistance médicale ; l'emploi d'administrateur des services de santé ; (XII) la famille d'emplois « logistique de santé » : l'emploi de gestionnaire en logistique de santé; l’emploi d'administrateur en logistique de santé ; Policy: Resolución Nº 028-2021-MINAM ─ Crea la Unidad Funcional de Delitos  Ambientales (UNIDA) del Ministerio del  Ambiente.
Policy_Content: La presente Resolución crea la Unidad Funcional de Delitos Ambientales (UNIDA) del Ministerio del Ambiente, dependiente del  Viceministerio de Gestión Ambiental, que tendrá las siguientes funciones: 1) Contribuir a la generación e intercambio de  información técnica relevante para la prevención,  reducción y seguimiento de los delitos e infracciones  ambientales con énfasis en la Tala Ilegal, Tráfico Ilícito de  Fauna Silvestre y Minería Ilegal; 2) Proporcionar análisis estratégicos relacionados con  la comisión de delitos e infracciones ambientales; 3) Diseñar y proponer mejoras normativas e  institucionales para prevenir y reducir la comisión de los  delitos e infracciones ambientales; 4) Coordinar con las entidades que conforman el  Sistema Nacional de Gestión Ambiental y el Sistema de Justicia para fortalecer la articulación en la prevención,  reducción y seguimiento de los delitos e infracciones  ambientales; 4) Elaborar y proponer los lineamientos y criterios  para la formulación, implementación y evaluación de las  políticas públicas sobre delitos e infracciones ambientales,  que permitan un adecuado y oportuno acceso a la  justicia ambiental, así como en la toma de decisiones  institucionales; 5) Coadyuvar en la implementación de las medidas  de reconocimiento y protección de los defensores  ambientales; 6) Proponer la invitación a otras instituciones  públicas, privadas o de la sociedad civil, la cooperación  internacional, entidades de fiscalización, así como a  profesionales especializados, para que contribuyan en la  formulación de recomendaciones específicas orientadas  a la prevención de los delitos ambientales e infracciones  ambientales.

Policy: Regulation on the collection of market data.
Policy_Content: This Regulation of the Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development, which is composed of 17 articles and one Annex, lays down: (1) detailed scope of the collection of data on agricultural market; (2) the way of indicating entrepreneurs obliged to provide this information; (3) the form and deadlines for submitting market data. The scope of data collection includes: (1) prices of purchase, sale, marketing, marketplace, wholesale, producers and importers; (2) trading volume; (3) particulars used to identify the exact agri-food commodity. The scope of the information to be provided and collected depends on the products concerned: beef, veal, pork, cereals, poultry, milk, dairy products, eggs, sugar, mutton, flax and hemp fiber, high-protein plants, milk-like preparations, fruits and vegetables, oil plants, hop and tobacco, fodder and flowers. The Annex specifies agricultural foodstuffs included in individual markets and detailed scope of market data collected for these foodstuffs.

Policy: Resolución de Dirección Ejecutiva RDE N⁰ D000033-2021-MIDAGRI-SERFOR-DE – Aprueba el Documento Técnico denominado “Contenido, Alcances y Generalidades del Módulo de Control del Sistema Nacional de Información Forestal y de Fauna Silvestre”.
Policy_Content: La presente Resolución aprueba el Documento Técnico denominado “Contenido, Alcances y Generalidades del Módulo de Control del Sistema Nacional de Información Forestal y de Fauna Silvestre”. El objetivo del documento es establecer la definición, alcance, estructura y procesos del Módulo de Control del Sistema Nacional de Información Forestal y de Fauna Silvestre (MC-SNIFFS), como un marco general de organización de los procesos que garanticen su funcionalidad. Se define que el Módulo de Control forma parte de la red articulada del SNIFFS y se constituye en una herramienta para la gestión sostenible de los recursos forestales y de fauna silvestre, vinculada con los mecanismos de administración y control que coadyuven en la acreditación del origen legal y la verificación de la trazabilidad de los productos y sub productos forestales y/o de fauna silvestre, mediante la toma de información adecuada y oportuna para la toma de decisiones a lo largo de la cadena productiva y de comercialización. Está conformado por un conjunto de datos, usuarios, procesos y tecnologías cuya interacción, bajo el cumplimiento de la normativa forestal y de fauna silvestre, provee la información que coadyuva al desarrollo de las acciones de control, supervisión, fiscalización y sanción en materia forestal y de fauna silvestre. Además de interactuar con los demás módulos y componentes del SNIFFS, así como con otros sistemas relevantes. Se establece el alcance del Módulo de Control, la estructura del Módulo de Control, y los procesos del Módulo de Control. También se establecen las acciones de integración e interoperabilidad del MC-SNIFFS.

Policy: Law of Georgia on Environmental Liability (No. 244-IVMS-XMP of 2021)
Policy_Content: The purpose of this Law is the legal regulation of issues related to environmental damage based on the 'polluter pays' principle. This law regulates legal relations related to the prevention of significant environmental damage, the mitigation of environmental damage or significant environmental damage, the measures to be taken in the event of environmental damage (including the implementation of remedial measures, and compensation for environmental damage and significant environmental damage). This Law shall apply to cases that are regulated by the international treaties of Georgia, unless otherwise provided for by the same international treaties. The further provides for prevention/mitigation of significant damage; measures to be implemented in the case of damage/significant damage; assessment of damage and making decisions by the Department; remedial measures; determining remedial measures; determining compensatory/adequate remedial measures at a site adjacent to the damaged area or at an alternative site; participation of interested parties in the process of determining remedial measures in the case of significant damage; coordinating with the Agency a plan of remedial measures and making amendments to it; implementation of remedial measures and supervision over the fulfilment of a plan of remedial measures; financial security for the risks of environmental damage; main goals of the environmental programme and the administration of its funds; the source of financing of the environmental programme; implementing and supervising measures financed from the environmental programme; and administrative offences, administrative proceedings and criminal liability. Additionally, the Law provides for the criteria for determining significant damage, including to biodiversity, land, water, and also provides for the particularly hazardous activities for the environment.

Policy: Loi n°2021‐23 du 02 mars 2021 relative aux contrats de Partenariat Public‐Privé.
Policy_Content: La présente loi a pour objet de régir les contrats de partenariat public‐privé. Les dispositions de la présente loi s’appliquent aux contrats de partenariat public‐privé  conclus dans tous les secteurs de la vie économique et sociale à l’exception des contrats  suivants: a) les contrats de partenariat public‐privé, tels que définis à l’article 3 de la présente  loi, régis par des dispositions législatives et réglementaires spécifiques aux secteurs  suivants :  -  les énergies ;  -  les mines ;  -  les télécommunications, au sens des activités régulées et soumises au régime de la  licence et de l’autorisation par le Code des communications électroniques; b) les contrats passés entre autorités contractantes, à l’exception des contrats de  partenariat public‐privé passés entre une société anonyme à participation publique  majoritaire dont le capital social n’est pas exclusivement détenu par des autorités  contractantes et une autre autorité contractante qui restent régis par la présente loi; c) les contrats ayant pour objet des besoins de défense et de sécurité nationale  exigeant le secret ou pour lesquels la protection des intérêts essentiels de l’État est  incompatible avec des mesures de publicité; d) les contrats attribués aux opérateurs économiques en vertu de droits exclusifs  octroyés par des dispositions législatives ou réglementaires nationales ; e)  les  contrats  conclus  avec  un  opérateur  économique  avec  lequel  l’autorité  contractante entretient une relation de quasi‐régie lorsque les conditions suivantes  sont réunies :  -  l’autorité contractante exerce sur l’opérateur économique un contrôle analogue à  celui qu’elle exerce sur ses propres services ;  -  l’opérateur économique contrôlé réalise au moins 80 % de son activité dans le  cadre des tâches qui lui sont confiées par l’autorité contractante qui le contrôle ou  par d’autres personnes morales que cette autorité contractante contrôle ;  -  l’opérateur économique contrôlé ne comporte pas de participation directe de  capitaux privés, à l’exception des formes de participation de capitaux privés sans  capacité de contrôle ou de blocage ; et f) les contrats portant sur la privatisation ou la cession des entreprises, biens et  équipements en infrastructure des autorités contractantes.
